# Microsoft identity platform documentation
> Documentation for building authentication and authorization with Microsoft Entra ID, Azure AD B2C, and Microsoft Graph.

This site provides developer guidance, API references, tutorials, and conceptual documentation for integrating identity, access, tokens, and app registration across Microsoft platforms.

## Getting Started
- [Microsoft identity platform documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/): Main landing page for Microsoft identity platform developer documentation.
- [Quickstart: Register an application in the Microsoft identity platform](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/quickstart-register-app): Create an app registration for authentication and API access.
- [Quickstart: Configure a client application to access a web API](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/quickstart-configure-app-access-web-apis): Grant delegated permissions and configure API access.
- [Authentication vs authorization](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/authentication-vs-authorization): Explains the difference between sign-in and access control concepts.
- [v2.0 endpoint overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/v2-overview): Overview of the Microsoft identity platform OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect endpoints.
- [App types and authentication flows](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/v2-app-types): Describes supported application types and recommended auth flows.

## Authentication Protocols and Flows
- [OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect protocols](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/active-directory-v2-protocols): Entry point for supported identity protocols and standards.
- [OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/v2-oauth2-auth-code-flow): Sign in users and obtain tokens for web and native apps.
- [OAuth 2.0 client credentials flow](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/v2-oauth2-client-creds-grant-flow): Acquire app-only tokens for daemon and service applications.
- [OAuth 2.0 on-behalf-of flow](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/v2-oauth2-on-behalf-of-flow): Exchange a user token to call downstream APIs.
- [OAuth 2.0 device code flow](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/v2-oauth2-device-code): Authenticate users on input-constrained devices.
- [OpenID Connect protocol](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/v2-protocols-oidc): Use OpenID Connect for user authentication and ID tokens.
- [SAML 2.0 bearer assertion flow](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/v2-saml-bearer-assertion): Use SAML assertions to obtain OAuth 2.0 access tokens.

## Tokens, Permissions, and Consent
- [Access tokens](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/access-tokens): Understand token format, claims, validation, and usage.
- [ID tokens](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/id-tokens): Learn how ID tokens represent authenticated users.
- [Refresh tokens](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/refresh-tokens): Understand token renewal and refresh token lifetimes.
- [Scopes, permissions, and consent](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/scopes-oidc): Explains delegated permissions, app roles, and user consent.
- [Claims customization using optional claims](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/optional-claims): Configure additional claims in tokens for applications.
- [Configure group claims for applications](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/howto-add-groups-claim): Add security group and directory role claims to tokens.
- [Token claims reference](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/access-token-claims-reference): Reference for common claims in Microsoft identity tokens.

## App Registration and Configuration
- [Application object and service principal objects](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/app-objects-and-service-principals): Understand app registrations and enterprise applications in Entra ID.
- [How to add app roles in your application](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/howto-add-app-roles-in-apps): Define application roles for authorization scenarios.
- [Expose a web API](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/quickstart-configure-app-expose-web-apis): Configure scopes and app roles for your API.
- [Configure redirect URIs](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/reply-url): Set redirect URIs for web, SPA, and native apps.
- [Certificates and secrets](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/how-to-add-credentials): Add client secrets or certificates to app registrations.
- [Publisher verification](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/publisher-verification-overview): Verify app publishers to improve trust and consent experience.
- [National clouds](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/authentication-national-cloud): Identity endpoints and considerations for sovereign cloud deployments.

## Libraries and SDKs
- [Microsoft Authentication Library (MSAL) overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/msal-overview): Overview of Microsoft client libraries for acquiring tokens.
- [MSAL for JavaScript](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/msal/javascript/): Documentation for browser and Node.js authentication libraries.
- [MSAL for Android](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/msal/android/): Android library guidance for sign-in and token acquisition.
- [MSAL for iOS and macOS](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/msal/objc/): Apple platform library documentation for authentication scenarios.
- [MSAL for .NET](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/msal/dotnet/): .NET library documentation for desktop, web, and daemon apps.
- [MSAL for Java](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/msal/java/): Java library documentation for desktop and server-side apps.
- [MSAL for Python](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/msal/python/): Python library documentation for confidential and public clients.
- [Microsoft.Identity.Web](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/microsoft-identity-web): ASP.NET helpers for authentication and downstream API access.

## Tutorials and Implementation Guides
- [Scenario: Single-page application](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/scenario-spa-overview): Guidance for building browser-based apps with secure sign-in.
- [Scenario: Web app that signs in users](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/scenario-web-app-sign-user-overview): Build server-rendered web apps with user authentication.
- [Scenario: Web API that calls web APIs](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/scenario-web-api-call-api-overview): Protect APIs and call downstream services on behalf of users.
- [Scenario: Daemon application](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/scenario-daemon-overview): Build background services using app-only authentication.
- [Scenario: Desktop app that calls web APIs](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/scenario-desktop-overview): Implement authentication in Windows and cross-platform desktop apps.
- [Scenario: Mobile app that calls web APIs](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/scenario-mobile-overview): Build native mobile apps with delegated API access.
- [Protected web API: Verify scopes and app roles](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/scenario-protected-web-api-verification-scope-app-roles): Validate authorization in APIs using scopes and roles.

## Single-Page Apps and Browser Guidance
- [Single-page application sign-in and sign-out](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/scenario-spa-sign-in): Implement interactive sign-in and sign-out in SPAs.
- [Single-page application: Acquire a token to call an API](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/scenario-spa-acquire-token): Obtain access tokens from browser applications securely.
- [Migration guide for SPAs from implicit flow to auth code flow](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/migrate-spa-implicit-to-auth-code): Move browser apps to recommended authorization code with PKCE.
- [Third-party cookie blocking in SPAs](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/reference-third-party-cookies-spas): Guidance for browser privacy changes affecting authentication.
- [Initialize client applications using MSAL.js](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/msal/javascript/browser/initialization): Set up MSAL.js browser clients and configuration.
- [Acquire and cache tokens using MSAL.js](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/msal/javascript/browser/acquire-token): Token acquisition patterns and cache behavior in browser apps.

## Web APIs and Downstream APIs
- [Protected web API overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/scenario-protected-web-api-overview): Core guidance for securing APIs with Microsoft identity platform.
- [Protected web API: App configuration](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/scenario-protected-web-api-app-configuration): Configure app registration and authentication settings for APIs.
- [Protected web API: Code configuration](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/scenario-protected-web-api-app-registration): Register and configure protected API applications.
- [Call a downstream web API from a web app](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/scenario-web-app-call-api-overview): Use delegated tokens to access APIs from web apps.
- [Call a downstream API from a web API](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/scenario-web-api-call-api-overview): Implement on-behalf-of token exchange in API chains.
- [Configure scopes exposed by a web API](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity-platform/quickstart-configure-app-expose-web-apis): Define delegated permissions for client applications.

## Azure AD B2C
- [Azure AD B2C documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/active-directory-b2c/): Documentation for customer identity and access management scenarios.
- [Tutorials for Azure AD B2C](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/active-directory-b2c/tutorial-create-tenant): Create and configure a B2C tenant for customer sign-in.
- [User flows in Azure AD B2C](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/active-directory-b2c/user-flow-overview): Configure built-in sign-up, sign-in, and profile editing flows.
- [Custom policies in Azure AD B2C](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/active-directory-b2c/custom-policy-overview): Extend identity journeys with Identity Experience Framework.
- [Enable authentication in your own web app using Azure AD B2C](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/active-directory-b2c/enable-authentication-web-application): Integrate B2C sign-in with web applications.
- [Enable authentication in a single-page application using Azure AD B2C](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/active-directory-b2c/enable-authentication-spa-app): Add customer authentication to browser-based applications.
- [Tokens overview in Azure AD B2C](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/active-directory-b2c/tokens-overview): Understand token issuance and claims in B2C.

## Related APIs and Platform Integration
- [Microsoft Graph authentication and authorization basics](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/auth/): Learn how Microsoft Graph uses Microsoft identity platform tokens.
- [Choose authentication providers for Microsoft Graph](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/sdks/choose-authentication-providers): Select auth patterns for Graph SDKs across languages.
- [Permissions reference for Microsoft Graph](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/permissions-reference): Reference for delegated and application permissions in Graph.
- [Microsoft Graph SDKs](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/sdks/sdks-overview): SDK documentation for calling Microsoft Graph from applications.
- [Microsoft Entra ID documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/): Broader Microsoft Entra identity documentation and administration guidance.
- [Workload identity federation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/workload-id/workload-identity-federation): Configure federated credentials for external workloads and CI/CD systems.
